lines.text: Did you know? Duc is Latin for lead.
Quick quiz! Which means down plus lead?

words.ex: The researchers conducted a survey of five hundred families.
The company launched three new products this year.
From the evidence, we can deduce that the site was abandoned suddenly.

publish.title: Duc root: conduct, product and deduce
publish.value: Duc comes from Latin "ducere" (to lead). Words: conduct, product and deduce. conduct = con + duct; product = pro + duct; deduce = de + duce.
